articles.title: Trump Signs Order to Create First-Ever US Space Academy
articles.summary: President Trump just announced the creation of the US Space Academy, a new school to train future space leaders. The surprise announcement came during a ceremony honoring the Artemis II crew, who recently flew around the moon.

articles.title: 'It's Essentially Been One Long Day': Daughter Searches for Parents After Nepal Floods
articles.summary: A North Carolina doctor is desperately searching for her parents after catastrophic floods in Nepal killed over 500 people. Shreya Ahuja last heard from them near the border, and now she's pleading for help.

articles.title: Chemical Tank Called 'Unfit for Service' Before Deadly Failure, Investigators Find
articles.summary: A chemical tank at a Washington paper mill was flagged as unsafe 10 months before it exploded, killing 11 workers. The company didn't fix it. Now the Chemical Safety Board is investigating.
